correction: A test helper that runs MyGo App.Run with no display must not only drop DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY: GDK on Wayland finds $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0 without WAYLAND_DISPLAY, and an inherited GDK_BACKEND or MYGO_ variable changes what Run does. Hold GDK_BACKEND=x11 with no DISPLAY, drop every MYGO_ variable, and put a deadline on the subprocess.
